name: Repo health check
description: Run the lint gate first and only wake the agent when the check fails.

tasks.title: Nightly lint gate
tasks.description: Cheap script gate: a clean lint run skips the agent entirely.
tasks.prompt:
The scheduled lint gate failed. Fix the reported problems.

Workspace contract: $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR is this task's root and it belongs to the task; the app only writes task.json, prompt.md, README.md and runs/<runId>/ (run.json, prompt.md, output.md, logs/) there, and the lint log is saved to $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/lint.log. Keep long-lived notes, such as recurring lint offenders or a suppression allow-list, in the task root (for example $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/notes.md) so the next run can reuse them. Prefer keeping everything inside the task root and the project directory.

1. Read the lint output.
2. Fix every reported problem (do not disable rules to make the gate pass).
3. Re-run the lint command locally and append what you changed to $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/notes.md.
tasks.command: if npm run lint --silent >"$SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR/lint.log" 2>&1; then printf '%s' '{"skip":true,"reason":"lint clean"}'; else printf '%s' '{"prompt":"The scheduled lint gate failed. Read the run log, fix the reported problems, and keep long-lived notes in the task root (SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR) before finishing."}'; fi
